Approved 2026-07-29: launch researchPrime (Heavy) as scoped, adversarial against both theses. Scope call also locked — if the calcification window cannot be cleared, Thesis B is PRESENTED WITH THE RISK STATED, not dropped.

Ledger delivered (710 lines). Thesis A UNSUPPORTED - not to be modelled. Thesis B survives as a narrow ~1-13B specialty indication with its longevity/productivity rationale REFUTED. Run did NOT converge (39 open high-severity findings, dryStreak 1/3) and honesty guard fired singleFamily:true - strong single-family audit, not cross-model verification.

Model premise materially changed by L1: Thesis A removed, Thesis B rescoped ~20x smaller and reframed to QoL QALYs with no mortality or productivity term. Cannot proceed until the principal re-scopes the deliverable.

receipt.why: Principal chose option 3: cross-family second opinion on the L1 kill conclusions before abandoning anything. L1 was single-family and did not converge.
Principal challenged the flat CPPD share and the productivity framing; both are re-tested

CONVERGED (dry) after 4 rounds, one binding 3-of-3 blocker fixed. Principal right on DIRECTION (CPPD share rises ~2.8x from 65-74 to 85+, doubling per decade, CORROBORATED across 3 countries) but wrong on MAGNITUDE (~0.4-1% of all elderly arthritis, ceiling 1-3% — BELOW L1's 1.5-5%). Non-wage economic channel confirmed real and sanctioned. Frame settled: societal-perspective CEA/QALY, not VSL.

Cross-family (cross_model:true, gemini refuters). Thesis A: 'unsupported' holds, 'strongly disfavoured' FAILS — prevention is untested not disfavoured, but UNPRICEABLE. CPPD share parameter RETIRED as unsourced. Productivity leg of L1 FAILS; mortality leg holds. Biggest finding: the campaign is optimising the SMALLER asset — R8 (oncology channel) now has a defensible answer.

605 lines. Retrieved the global age distribution L5 had recorded as NOT LOCATED (GLOBOCAN 2024 production API, validated against IARC fact sheet, corroborated by WHO GHE to 1.6pp). CORRECTS THE STEWARD: 38.1% of global cancer deaths are before 65, not 25% — the 25.5% figure is US/high-income. Raised aggregate human-capital loss 78% to $494.5bn/yr. Recommends AGAINST the human-capital reframe: keep VLY as headline, use working-age as non-additive floor.

2-page PDF in ADNOC house style, rendered via Chrome headless. Carries the discounted tables, the GDP-per-capita floor alongside the VLY basis, the working-age exhibit with its correction, and the open items.

531 lines. Q1 SETTLED IN THE THESIS'S FAVOUR: ANKH exports ATP not PPi, so ENPP1 is an obligate downstream step. But risk relocated: ENPP1's share of joint ATP-to-PPi conversion is only 30-45%; joint PPi has never been measured under inhibition and plasma is an invalid proxy; and the drug prevents new deposition but cannot dissolve existing deposits (structural). Corrected a citation error in L4 that had propagated onto a slide.
